conventions.theta: absolute tracked angle, deg (template zero of 11-06)
conventions.a: mean field acceleration over the 0.25 s pulse, rad/s^2, B2 definition, divided by kappa (AC-tail start offset, V^2 assumed); a_raw without that
conventions.F: a_q(theta) = S(level) * F(theta - s_q), F = c8 cos8x + s8 sin8x + c16 cos16x + s16 sin16x + const, coef in that order
conventions.landing_host: host write time + relative landing delay, refitted drift; absolute latency unknown
